def make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return n distinct record ids, the same list on every run for the same seed.

    Id i is seed * 1000000 + i for i in 0..n-1, so ids from different seeds
    do not overlap either.
    """
    pre n >= 0 and n <= 1000000
    pre seed >= 0 and seed <= 1000000
    post out.len() == n
    post {x for x in out}.len() == n
    ex make_ids(0, 5) == []
    ex make_ids(3, 2) == [2000000, 2000001, 2000002]
    base = seed * 1000000
    return [base + i for i in range(n)]
